title: LS_34160_PH_ManilaWalk.mp3 by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Walking in Manila, Philippines. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effect). This binaural audio file is one of the recordings I made in Manila a few days before Christmas 2018, while I was rambling in the shops and in the crowded streets of Divisoria and Baklaran, which are two places where you can find many sellers and vendors who sell everything you’d like to buy... Here, I’m walking in a crowded street surrounded by many small shops, and you can hear a police car trying to go slowly through the crowd.
